title: REQ · Empty round yields an empty list and source errors propagate
summary: Empty frozen set gives non-nil empty contributions; source errors are wrapped and returned
description: When the snapshot freezes no ids, or the round has no contributions, Export returns Contributions as an empty non-nil slice so JSON shows []. Errors from FrozenIDs (including ErrNotFound) and ListByRound are returned wrapped with %w.
acceptance_criteria: Given empty frozen ids, When Export runs, Then json.Marshal output contains "contributions":[]
Given FrozenIDs returns ErrNotFound, When Export runs, Then errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) is true

in_scope: empty-round and error paths of Export

definition_of_done: Empty and error paths behave as specified
